en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4686 - In the narration of Al-Sakooni from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as),
it is reported that a man came to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) and said: "My bondwoman has breastfed my child, and I want to sell her."
Imam (as) replied: "Take her by the hand and say, 'Who will buy from me the mother of my child?'"
